children: US construction services firm's Q3 revenue rose 40% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose 61% yr/yr
Company completed Epsilon Industries acquisition and raised 2026 revenue and EBITDA guidance
Everus raises 2026 revenue outlook to $5.0 bln-$5.1 bln from $4.5 bln-$4.7 bln
Company lifts 2026 EBITDA forecast to $485 mln-$495 mln from $410 mln-$425 mln
Everus maintains 2026 capital expenditures guidance at $90 mln-$100 mln
ORGANIC GROWTH - Co said Q3 revenue growth was primarily driven by organic expansion in electrical, mechanical, transmission and distribution segments
DATA CENTER AND HIGH-TECH DEMAND - Co attributed segment revenue growth to continued strength in data center and high-tech submarkets
ACQUISITION IMPACT - Co said Epsilon Industries acquisition expanded modular construction capabilities and contributed to backlog growth
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", 4 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Everus Construction Group, Inc. is $170.00, about 65.1% above its November 2 closing price of $102.99
The stock recently traded at 18 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 26 three months ago
